title: Give your full-back a way out
titleKid: Give your teammate a way out
brief: Your keeper plays it out to your full-back, and their winger closes in.
briefKid: Your keeper passes wide to a teammate. Their winger runs at them.
question: Your full-back is trapped near the touchline. Where do you go?
questionKid: Your teammate is stuck by the sideline. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: When a teammate is pinned on the touchline, offer a pass behind and inside them, at an angle and with no opponent in the lane, so there is always a way out.
takeaway.kid: Teammate stuck by the sideline? Offer a pass back and inside, to you.

misconceptions.text: You stayed in the middle, so the pass back to you is long and their #9 can step across and cut it out.
misconceptions.textKid: You stayed in the middle. That pass is too long and easy to steal.

misconceptions.text: You came up level with your full-back, so a pass to you goes square across their winger, and losing it there is a goal chance for them.
misconceptions.textKid: Too level with your teammate. Stay a bit behind so the pass is safe.
